items.title: The Day Mirror 1 Arrived!
items.caption:
It was 29 October 2025

This was the day my first Magic Mirror arrived.

Gemma and I unpacked it and couldn’t wait to try it.

The mirror was exactly what I’d hoped for…

The software wasn’t.

It wasn’t terrible.

It just wasn’t really… anything.

And it definitely wasn’t me.

So I did what anyone would do.

I started searching online for another program.

Surely someone had already built exactly what I wanted?

I found lots of options.

Some looked okay.

But every one of them wanted another monthly subscription, and none of them felt quite right.

At the time I wasn’t thinking,

“I’m going to build my own software.”

I was thinking,

“There has to be something out there that does exactly what I want.”

I kept looking.

And looking.

Eventually I realised…

I was describing a product that didn’t seem to exist.

At some point I stopped searching for software…

…and started making a list of everything I wished it could do.

Then that list kept growing.

Not just with the things I wanted…

…but with ideas I didn’t even know I wanted in a photo booth.

I never planned to build software.

I never planned to build a website.

I definitely never planned to spend the next nine months lear
items.alt: Gemma & I posing (confused) together in front of the 1st Magic Mirror the day it arrived at home 9 months ago.
